description: MainActivity.java for an Android Tic-Tac-Toe game featuring two players: King and Queen, with game logic, UI interactions, and sound effects.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing game state, UI updates, and user interactions for the Tic-Tac-Toe game with custom player icons.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes game components, binds UI elements, and sets up the game when activity starts.

methods.name: onCellClicked
methods.description: Handles user taps on game grid cells, updating game state, checking for wins or draws, and switching players.

methods.name: showEndGame
methods.description: Displays the game result message and updates UI colors based on the outcome.

methods.name: updateScoreboard
methods.description: Updates the scoreboard display with current scores and games played.

methods.name: updateStatusText
methods.description: Updates status message indicating which player's turn it is.

methods.name: isBoardFull
methods.description: Checks whether the game board is full, indicating a draw.

methods.name: togglePlayer
methods.description: Switches the current player between King and Queen.

methods.name: restartGame
methods.description: Resets the game board to start a new round while preserving the scoreboard.

methods.name: setupGame
methods.description: Initializes or resets game state variables for a new game session.

methods.name: checkForWin
methods.description: Determines if a specified player has achieved a winning condition on the board.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases media resources when activity is destroyed.
